facts.fact: The IMF reports Guinea-Bissau launched the National Summary Data Page on its national Open Data Platform, giving macroeconomic data in human- and machine-readable form; dated to the release date as no launch date is given.
The IMF states the data on the page is provided by the National Institute of Statistics, the Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank of West African States.

systems.country_label: National Summary Data Page on Guinea-Bissau's Open Data Platform (guinebissau.opendataforafrica.org/nsdp)
systems.platform: African Development Bank Open Data Platform
systems.owner: National Institute of Statistics, Ministry of Finance, BCEAO

note: No open licence stated; platform is AfDB-provided but the release says the national bodies provide the data.
